name: rhythm-forge-desktop
description: A local-first desktop MVP for rhythm-game music creation.

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-packager . "Rhythm Forge" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune --ignore="^/(release.*|\.git|\.github|\.npm-cache|\.electron-cache|\.tmp.*|\.package-stage.*)$" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "release/Rhythm Forge-darwin-arm64/Rhythm Forge.app"
